For SN318 and above, only a single number was confirmed in the NTN data with no distinction between the two sides, so it is listed as a single number. The † mark indicates an item confirmed from only a single source, and “Inquire” indicates an item that could not be confirmed from published data. In addition, large sizes of SN318 and above are listed as “S3xx” in overseas data, and for SN324 and SN326, the width (A) dimension may differ from our table by about ±5mm depending on the manufacturer.
